prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
A `#[repr(packed(N))]` struct cannot contain a `#[repr(align(M))]` type, even when `N >= M`. This restriction is transitive, so nesting the aligned type does not bypass it. The compiler reports:

```text
error[E0588]: packed type cannot transitively contain a `#[repr(align)]` type
```

`repr(packed(N))` forces alignment to be at most `N`, while `repr(align(M))` forces alignment to be at least `M`; Rust disallows using these representations together in this way. ([Rust issue #100743](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/100743), [Rustonomicon](https://docs.adacore.com/live/wave/rust/html/rust_ug/_static/nomicon/other-reprs.html))
